turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
The rule: some common verbs have their own past form, with no -ed: go - went, buy - bought, see - saw.
Right: "Last night our cat caught a mouse."
Wrong: "Last night our cat catched a mouse." Catch has its own past form, caught, so catched is wrong.
I show you one: "Last spring the swallows came back." Come has its own past: came.
Your turn. Write the past form of 'have':
Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
